title: Marvell strikes $115B deal for Lumentum
content: Marvell is acquiring Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at $115 billion, representing $1,132 per share of Lumentum common stock. #pressrelease

title: T-Mobile rolls out 5-Gig fiber, with 10-year price lock
content: T-Mobile has introduced a $90 per month 5-Gig fiber broadband plan that features a ten-year price lock. #pressrelease

title: HKT pulls out of US under FCC pressure – report
content: Another Chinese telco is reportedly leaving the US as Hong Kong-based HKT is said to be withdrawing from the country after pressure from the FCC, which has in the past placed prohibitions on major Chinese telcos on the grounds of national security and law enforcement.

title: Comcast state-level layoff warnings start to roll in
content: WARN filings show that show Comcast is laying off 634 people in Philadelphia, 159 in Washington, 119 in New Jersey and 82 in California. About 25% of the cuts in Washington are construction jobs, but won't impact the pace of network builds.

title: Cable One sets up committee to 'evaluate strategic alternatives'
content: Cable One disclosed that Paul Keglevic, a former Frontier board member during the company's bankruptcy, joined the Cable One board, and it set up a new special committee tasked with exploring strategic alternatives.
